_schema.description: Sportsbet 'Victorian State Election - Seat Betting' markets per district. Entered by hand from screenshots of the page taken 30 Oct 2026 (Sportsbet blocks automated fetching, so refresh.py keeps this file as manual). 'Any Other' options are recorded but never count as favourite.

fields.mode: manual (entered or kept by hand) | auto (last values fetched by refresh.py)
fields.date_checked: YYYY-MM-DD the prices were taken (shown as 'as at <date>')
fields.seats: One per district: {district, favourite (party code, or null if partial or a joint favourite), price (favourite's decimal price), joint_favourites (party codes when the shortest price is shared), favourite_candidate (when the favourite is a named independent), options: [{label as shown, party code or null for 'Any Other', candidate (named independents), price}], partial (true when the shortest-priced options were cut off), more_options_hidden (true when Sportsbet folded further, longer-priced options under 'Show All'), date_checked}
